Items before: yogurt cup (~170g, ~110 kcal), muffin (~70g, ~250 kcal), strawberries (~50g, 15 kcal), canned peaches (~70g, 45 kcal), water, orange juice (~200ml, 90 kcal), 2 margarine portions (~7g each; one seems unused and one opened, with some left on the plate, so ~1 eaten, ~25 kcal), fried egg (~45g, 90 kcal), mushrooms (~30g, 20 kcal), grilled tomato (~60g, 15 kcal), toast 2 slices (~60g, 160 kcal).

After: the muffin is eaten, the yogurt is eaten, both bowls are empty, the juice is gone, and the plate is empty apart from a bit of butter. The margarine packets are still on the tray, so probably unused, with a small butter smear on the plate. The butter dish on the plate suggests a portion was used on the toast, so I'll count ~7g, ~25 kcal.

Total kcal: 110+250+15+45+90+90+20+15+160+25 = 820.
Mass: 170+70+50+70+200+45+30+60+60+7 = 762.
